environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` with action BLOCK and priority 50, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 100. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (VPC with no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on the private subnet), preventing data exfiltration via out-of-band channels. CloudWatch Logs Insights anomaly detection triggers on query patterns containing UNION or semicolons.

config.network: private subnet, no NAT gateway, no IGW, VPC endpoints for ECR/CloudWatch only
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights anomaly detection on SQL keywords
